notes: v2.5.21 - recommended update. A new revision system for engineering, switched on per project from the eBOM header (every project starts with it off; the orange ? next to the Revision Map explains it). Revision state now updates live between engineers, CATIA tree problems are listed with what to do, and the final walkthrough fixes are in. Also: an Outsourcing board, a Hardware list in Inventory, RP Queue, Quotes, Purchasing, Receiving and Workforce Planner improvements. This release updates the database behind AOS, so please update when prompted.
